sourceNote: PRIMARY MEASUREMENT, with caveats stated. The Elite Fourum community tally counted n=7,020 Sun & Moon base packs: overall hit rate (anything above a Holo Rare) 17.65% +/-0.89% = 1 in 5.67 packs, broken out as Holo GX 11.15% (1 in 9), full-art Ultra Rare 4.22% (1 in 24), Rainbow Rare 1.47% (1 in 68), Secret Rare 0.81% (1 in 123). Mapped onto this set's two normalized tiers by what each holds: ultra_rare = Holo GX plus the full-art Ultra Rares = 11.15+4.22 = 15.37%; hyper_rare = the #150+ rainbow and gold secret range = 1.47+0.81 = 2.28%. The two tiers sum to 17.65%, exactly the study's stated overall hit rate, which is the cross-check that confirms the mapping. WHY THIS IS MEDIUM AND NOT HIGH: unlike the TCGplayer Authentication Center studies used for Evolving Skies and Lost Origin, this was counted from YouTube/Twitch opening videos rather than from sealed product the counter bought, it blends booster boxes with Elite Trainer Boxes and prerelease kits, and the author lost the raw dataset so it cannot be audited. Video sourcing carries an unquantified UPWARD bias (uploaders choose which openings to publish, and creator-supplied product may be pre-sorted), so if this number is wrong it most likely overstates. It nonetheless passes an internal integer check - back-solving each tier against n=7,020 yields whole card counts (783 GX, 296 UR, 103 Rainbow, 57 Secret) - which is strong evidence of a genuine tally rather than a figure written backwards from a percentage. This REPLACES an unsourced era aggregate that put ultra_rare at 18% and hyper_rare at 3%.
